I am 56 years old. I finished middle school. I have farmed for 30 years. My family has two people—my husband and me. My husband works construction in Handan city for part of the year. We have 9.5 mu of flat land in Quzhou County. I plant 6 mu with winter wheat followed by summer maize, and 3.5 mu with cotton. That is what my neighbors do, so I do the same.

For wheat, I sowed last October with Jimai 22 improved seed at 35 jin per mu. I already put the basal fertilizer then—100 jin of 18-18-6 compound per mu. Now it is early spring and the wheat is greening up. I will topdress with 40 jin of urea per mu. That gives me about 18 kg of nitrogen per mu in total. The compound gives 9 kg of phosphorus and 3 kg of potassium per mu. I do not buy extra potassium—it costs too much and my soil is okay. I will irrigate four times: the winter irrigation I already did in December, plus green-up water, jointing water, and grain-filling water. I flood the fields from my well. For sprays, I do three times: herbicide once in March, insecticide once for aphids, and fungicide once before heading. I expect 480 kg per mu. Last year I got 450 kg, so I am adding a bit more urea this time.

For maize, after I harvest the wheat in early June, I sow Denghai 605 hybrid seed directly into the wheat stubble without plowing. If you wait more than two days after harvest, the yield drops, so no-tillage is the only way. I put 40 kg of 26-8-8 compound per mu at sowing, then topdress with 15 kg urea per mu when the maize is knee-high. That is about 17 kg nitrogen, 3 kg phosphorus, and 3 kg potassium per mu. I irrigate twice—at jointing and at filling. Pesticides three times: herbicide at sowing, insecticide once for corn borer, and fungicide once if the leaves spot. I expect 600 kg per mu.

For cotton, I rotary-till the 3.5 mu in mid-April. I plant Guoxinmian improved Bt cotton seed at 3 jin per mu under plastic film around April 25th. Basal fertilizer is 50 kg of 20-10-10 compound per mu. At flowering I topdress with 25 kg urea per mu. That comes to about 22 kg nitrogen, 5 kg phosphorus, and 5 kg potassium per mu. Cotton needs a lot of water—I irrigate four times: at sowing, at flowering, at boll stage, and at late boll. I spray pesticides 8 times. Even with Bt cotton, aphids and red spider mites still attack. The dealer told me a new chemical works on both, so I hope 8 times is enough this year. Last year I sprayed 10 times. I expect 450 kg of seed cotton per mu.

My neighbor Wang’s wife uses almost the same amounts. If she gets a good harvest, I copy her. I do not try new things unless I see them work on her field first. Fertilizer will cost me about 3,000 yuan this year for all crops, plus another 1,500 for seed and pesticide. That is a lot of money. But my husband brings cash home from construction, so we can manage. I would rather spend too much on fertilizer than risk a bad harvest. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is just a cost.
